notes: «قالا لقينا عبد الله بن عمر»: the two co-transmitters speak in a narrated encounter with Ibn Umar, who tells the report «عن عمر». Ibn Umar and Umar are both written as links here (rule 6), but which of them is the last transmitter of the saying is not settled by the text. Needs a ruling. «- رضى الله عنه -» is an honorific.
